title: East vs. Garfield — Football (2025–2026)
summary: The Dragons finish an unbeaten league campaign with a city championship-clinching win.
article_headline: East Beats Garfield 32–12 to Clinch Akron City Series Crown
article_dek: The Dragons finish an unbeaten league campaign with a city championship-clinching win.
article_body:
AKRON, Ohio — East captured the 2025 Akron City Series championship with a 32–12 victory over Garfield on Friday, October 24. The Dragons ended the regular season with a perfect 5–0 league record and an 8–2 overall mark, as reported by Akron Public Schools.

This was more than another late-season game. East's win clinched the city title and secured a place in the OHSAA Division III, Region 9 playoffs. The Dragons built a 20-point winning margin in the rivalry contest.

Summit County Sports' photography records the atmosphere and football action behind an important night for East's program. Verified team results are reported here without attributing unsourced touchdown plays.
article_highlights: East defeated Garfield 32–12 on October 24, 2025, to secure the Akron City Series championship.
The Dragons finished the regular season 8–2 overall and 5–0 in league competition.
East's 20-point win over the Rams secured an OHSAA Division III, Region 9 playoff berth, according to Akron Public Schools.
